items.headline: claude made me a worse writer. i used to think before i wrote. now i prompt before i think. the quality of my THINKING declined even as the output improved.
items.summary: solo dev. 16 months using claude daily. the realization: my first drafts before claude were rougher but more thoughtful. i'd stare at the blank page and think. the thinking produced insights that the writing captured. now: i open claude and start describing what i need. the model fills the gaps. the output is polished. the thinking that would have happened in the gap between "i don't know what to write" and "i'll figure it out" never happens. the AI bridges the gap instantly.
